# Branding and templates

This directory contains user-owned themes and templates. Do not commit confidential company documents, logos, or customer data.

## Recommended layout

```text
styles/
├── default.json
└── corporate-blue.json

templates/
├── README.md
├── report.docx                 # optional user template
├── budget.xlsx                 # optional user template
├── deck.pptx                   # optional user template
└── manifest.example.json       # placeholder/data mapping example
```

Use a template only when the user has permission to modify and redistribute it.
